product_overview: Zumra is a secure, multi‑tenant backend API that enables training facilities to manage users, courses, live/recorded lessons, assignments and payments (Stripe) with facility‑scoped roles and JWT authentication.
core_goals: Provide secure, JWT‑based authentication (email + Google OAuth) with email confirmation and OTP password reset.
Enable facilities to manage courses, sections, lessons, batches and groups with fine‑grained facility roles and policies.
Support course commerce via cart and Stripe checkout and grant access after successful payment.
Support assignments/tasks and submissions with instructor review and grading.
Expose a stable API for frontend consumption (React) with CORS and OpenAPI readiness and scale securely.

features.name: Authentication & Account Management
features.description: Allow users to register, confirm email, login (email/password or Google), and recover/reset passwords using OTP; return JWT tokens for authenticated requests.
user_flows: POST /Auth/Account/Register with {Email, Password, Name} -> Receive 200 success message (confirmation email sent) -> GET /Auth/Account/Confirm?token={token}&id={id} -> Receive 200 success -> POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token
POST /Auth/Account/Register with existing Email -> Receive 400 with errors (email already exists)
POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials but email not confirmed -> Receive 400 with message indicating email confirmation required

POST /Auth/Account/ForgotPassword with {Email} -> Receive 200 (generic message) -> POST /Auth/Account/VerifyOTP with {Email, Otp} (correct code) -> Receive 200 success -> POST /Auth/Account/ResetPassword with {Email, Password} -> Receive 200 password reset success
POST /Auth/Account/ForgotPassword with {Email} -> Receive 200 (generic message) -> POST /Auth/Account/VerifyOTP with {Email, Otp} (wrong/expired) -> Receive 400 invalid/expired OTP

GET /Auth/Account/ExternalLogin?provider=google&returnUrl={url} -> Receive 302 challenge redirect to Google -> (after provider) GET /Auth/Account/ExternalLoginCallback -> Receive 200 with {success:true, token, email, username}
GET /Auth/Account/ExternalLoginCallback without valid external info -> Receive 400 or error (external login failed)

features.name: Facility Management
features.description: Create, update, delete and retrieve facilities (training centers); activate facility via Stripe checkout session; facility operations require appropriate JWT and facility role.
user_flows: POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /Api/Facility/Create with form-data {Name, Description, Type, CategoryId, Image?} and Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 201 with created facility data {id, name, category}
POST /Api/Facility/Create without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized

POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials (facility owner) -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /Api/Facility/Pay with Authorization: Bearer {token} and {facilityId} -> Receive 200 with {CheckoutUrl} -> GET /Api/Facility/Success (Stripe callback after checkout) -> Receive 200 success (facility activated)

POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /Api/Facility/Pay with Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 with {CheckoutUrl} -> GET /Api/Facility/Cancel (user cancelled payment) -> Receive 200 {success:false}

features.name: Category Management
features.description: Allow listing and management (create/update/delete) of course categories. Reads are public; writes require JWT with appropriate role.
user_flows: GET /Api/Category/GetAll -> Receive 200 with Category[]

POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /Api/Category/Create with {Name, Description} and Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 with created Category
POST /Api/Category/Create without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized

PUT /Auth/Account/Login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PUT /Api/Category/Update/{id} with Authorization: Bearer {token} and {Name, Description} -> Receive 200 updated Category
PUT /Api/Category/Update/{nonexistentId} with Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Course Management
features.description: Create, update, delete and retrieve courses tied to facilities and categories; courses contain metadata used for enrollment and payments.
user_flows: GET /Api/Course/GetAll -> Receive 200 with Course[]

POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /Api/Course/Create with {Title, Description, CategoryId, FacilityId, Price, ...} and Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 with Course
POST /Api/Course/Create without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized

POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /Api/Course/Create with {Title,...} -> Receive 200 Course -> GET /Api/Course/GetById/{id} -> Receive 200 Course details
GET /Api/Course/GetById/{invalidId} -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Batch Management
features.description: Manage course batches (cohorts) for scheduling and capacity; operations require authenticated user scoped to the facility/role.
user_flows: POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /Api/Batch/Create with {CourseId, StartDate, EndDate, Capacity} and Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 with Batch
POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /Api/Batch/GetAll with Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 with Batch[]
GET /Api/Batch/GetAll without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized
PUT /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PUT /Api/Batch/Update/{id} with Authorization: Bearer {token} and update payload -> Receive 200 updated Batch

features.name: Group Management
features.description: Manage student groups within batches (create, update, delete, list) for organizing learners; protected by JWT and facility role policies.
user_flows: POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /Api/Group/Create with {BatchId, Name, Capacity} and Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 with Group
POST /Api/Group/Create without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized
POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /Api/Group/GetAll with Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 with Group[]
DELETE /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> DELETE /Api/Group/Delete/{id} with Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 {success:true}

features.name: Section Management
features.description: Create and manage sections (modules) inside a course to group lessons; write operations require JWT and appropriate facility role.
user_flows: POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /Api/Section/Create with {CourseId, Title, Description} and Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 with Section
POST /Api/Section/Create without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized
POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /Api/Section/GetAll?courseId={courseId} with Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 with Section[]
PUT /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PUT /Api/Section/Update/{id} with Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 updated Section

features.name: Lesson Management
features.description: Add and manage lessons inside sections, including recorded lessons (Bunny) and live lessons (Jitsi); actions require JWT and facility role.
user_flows: POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /Api/Lesson/Create with {SectionId, Title, Type:LessonRec, BunnyVideoId} and Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 with Lesson

POST /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /Api/Lesson/Create with {SectionId, Title, Type:LessonLive, JitsiRoom, Schedule} and Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 with Lesson
POST /Api/Lesson/Create without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized
GET /Auth/Account/Login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /Api/Lesson/GetAll?sectionId={sectionId} with Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 with Lesson[]

features.name: Task Management
features.description: Instructors create assignments/tasks for courses/lessons; students submit tasks and instructors review/grade; create/update/delete/list endpoints are protected by JWT.
user_flows: POST /Auth/Account/Login with instructor credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /Api/Task/Create with {CourseId, LessonId, Title, Description, DueDate} and Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 with Task
POST /Auth/Account/Login with student credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /Api/Task/GetAll with Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 with Task[]
POST /Api/Task/Create without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized
PUT /Auth/Account/Login with instructor credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PUT /Api/Task/Update/{id} with Authorization: Bearer {token} and updated fields -> Receive 200 updated Task
DELETE /Auth/Account/Login with instructor credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> DELETE /Api/Task/Delete/{id} with Authorization: Bearer {token} -> Receive 200 {success:true}

known_limitations.issue: Email confirmation required before login (ASPNET Identity setting)
known_limitations.impact: Tests that attempt to login with newly registered users will fail unless email is confirmed

known_limitations.issue: Stripe payment integration requires live keys for facility activation
known_limitations.impact: Pay/Success endpoints require valid Stripe configuration

known_limitations.issue: JWT auth required for most write operations
known_limitations.impact: Tests for create/update/delete endpoints need a valid JWT token
